name: Microsoft Entra B2B collaboration
short_description: Business-to-business collaboration in Microsoft Entra that adds external users to a directory as guest objects so they can access apps and resources.

evidence.quote: The first is business to business activity, which covers guest sign ins, guest registrations
The scenario is business to business collaboration or B2B.
Entra ID. External partners federate via B2B, get scoped access to specific workspaces and never see raw canonical
From Guests to B to be Microsoft's external collaboration makeover.
